Can I buy guns online? I thought I looked this up years ago and I could but I did a quick internet search and I'm seeing fake looking sites.

You CAN buy guns online, but if they use gunpowder, they can't be shipped directly to you. They have to be shipped to a local FFL dealer (federal firearms license) in your state, and you can pick them up from the FFL after filling out your form 4473.

Note that most FFLs charge a fee for receiving a gun you bought online, and that fee is usually anywhere from $10-30. Some will waive a fee if you buy something like ammo from them, and some have partnerships with various websites/companies, but you should always ask FIRST.

Gunbroker.com is a fine site for buying stuff via auction, but that comes with the usual caveat emptor you get with an auction site.

Air guns (no gunpowder, just compressed air/CO2) can actually be shipped to you with no background check despite the fact that some are powerful enough to hunt deer with, and thus to kill people too.

EDIT: This all assumes you're in the USA

The only thing you can purchase and have shipped to you without using an FFL is parts that don't require a serial number. So in the case of an AR-15, you can ship everything to your door except the lower receiver. THAT falls under the same rules as a regular firearm. So you can buy barrels, uppers, trigger assembly, magazines, etc. - everything else.

Find a local FFL on gunbroker.com (there's probably one within a couple miles of you), contact him and find out the terms, and order away.
